A comment at line 603 in memo_service.go mentions DispatchMemoCreatedWebhook.

The dispatcher is `DispatchMemoCreatedWebhook`, defined in `server/router/api/v1/memo_service_webhooks.go` and called from `CreateMemo` in `memo_service.go`.

HTTP delivery is performed by `internal/webhook.PostAsync` and `webhook.Post`, using the standard library `net/http` client. No external webhook delivery library such as svix is present in go.mod.

The signing mechanism is Standard Webhooks using HMAC-SHA256. It sets the `webhook-id`, `webhook-timestamp`, and `webhook-signature` headers with a `v1,` prefix. Comments explicitly reference the "Standard Webhooks" specification.

A directory issue caused the initial grep search to fail.

A more careful find-and-grep approach is needed. The function may have moved since line 603 contains a comment. I will inspect memo_service.go around that area and check the documentation.

The memo webhook notification flow is now clear. I am ready to cite the dispatcher, delivery package, and signing mechanism.

`CreateMemo` in `memo_service.go` calls `DispatchMemoCreatedWebhook` in `server/router/api/v1/memo_service_webhooks.go`. That function invokes `webhook.PostAsync` from the `internal/webhook` package. HTTP delivery uses `net/http` (`http.Client`). Request signing is Standard Webhooks HMAC-SHA256 with `webhook-id`, `webhook-timestamp`, and `webhook-signature` headers.
